communicationChains.title: Large Money Chain
communicationChains.description: A chain of symbolic actions across multiple events that could have been misinterpreted as signaling large money/laundering interest. In reality, these were legitimate business aspirations (unicorn startups), personal items (anime mug), and convenience (cigarettes). However, combined with billionaire talk, these may have built a profile that attracted criminal interest.

entries.action: Bought cigarettes, smoked one, left rest on jackpot machine
entries.perceivedMeaning: Signaling desire for large payout or having large sums to work with
entries.reality: Just didn't want the rest of the cigarettes, set them down conveniently

entries.action: Talked about wanting to be a billionaire and working on multiple businesses
entries.perceivedMeaning: Has money or ambitions worth investigating/recruiting
entries.reality: Legitimate business aspirations - building companies to help kids learn and improve work motivation

entries.perceivedMeaning: Having $1B+ to launder (unicorn in criminal context)
entries.reality: Unicorn = startup worth $1B+, legitimate business aspiration for companies being built

entries.action: Had Slime mug visible on counter at home during event
entries.reality: Anime reference - 'That Time I Reincarnated as a Slime' - actually means perceived as slime but capable/intelligent, history of resetting and learning

entries.action: Mentioned needing sharpies in apartment; sharpie markings appeared at Panera
entries.perceivedMeaning: Confirmation of surveillance, they were watching and responding
entries.reality: Confirmed apartment surveillance - sharpie markings appeared after mentioning sharpies

entries.action: Left Slime mug in mailroom as final communication
entries.reality: Intentional response acknowledging knowledge of observation and multiple interpretations

perspectives.author: matt
perspectives.interpretation: Pattern of signals built a profile of someone with large money or ambitions: jackpot placement, unicorn writing, billionaire talk. Worth investigating/recruiting.

perspectives.author: matt
perspectives.interpretation: Narrator legitimately building companies intended to be unicorns. Symbolic items like slime mug were personal interests. Misinterpretation led to unwanted attention.

communicationChains.notes: Chain spans multiple events and locations. Sharpie surveillance confirmation proves these actions were being observed.
